subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Romance Scams Begin
description: Learn How Romance Scams Begin in one minute.

hook.text: A gorgeous profile, perfect messages, and genuine emotional connection. It's all manufactured.

buildup.text: Romance scammers spend weeks building emotional bonds before mentioning money.

discovery.text: They use stolen photos of attractive people and scripts refined over thousands of interactions.

twist.text: The scammer may manage 20 romantic relationships simultaneously using the same playbook.

climax.text: Romance scams are the costliest consumer fraud — over $1.3 billion reported lost in 2022.

punchline.text: The connection felt real. The person behind it wasn't.

quiz.question: How much was lost to romance scams in 2022?
